outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of breast anatomy plus a classification table listing subtype frequencies; it contains no plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating circadian clock-based phenotypes and study aims; no data plot is present.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method; no data plot is present.
Panel D shows idealized line traces (illustrative circadian signal examples) within a schematic; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E depicts a schematic correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F shows an illustrative line plot of cell number growth curves within a schematic; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G shows an illustrative dose-response line plot within a schematic; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel H depicts schematic gene-expression heatmaps and a mutation grid; heatmaps/tables are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel I shows illustrative PCA and 3D scatter plots within a schematic; scatter plots inherently show individual points and are exempt from this check.
